findings.note: His points plus rebounds in the last five games were 28, 34, 36, 23 and 32, so he went over 29.5 in 3 of 5. He played 36-38 minutes in the overs. The one game under 29.5 was 18 pts and 5 reb. A 19-and-9 fell short in 29 minutes of a blowout loss to Dallas.

ESPN's preview of this Nets @ Pelicans game shows Porter averaging 21.5 points and 7.7 rebounds this season, about 29.2 combined. That sits right at the 29.5 line, so the season averages favor neither side clearly.

A CBS Sports opinion piece from about four days ago says Porter's volume is down with Julius Randle on the roster. Brooklyn was 2-6 at that point. This suggests his usage is lower than last season, when he averaged 24.2 points.
